title: HyperFrames player
description: Your own HyperFrames block (one HTML file: markup, CSS and a paused GSAP timeline in window.__timelines) played as it is inside an iframe; the stage only moves its timeline. Without a file the kit's own card block plays, a good file to copy and change.

source.note: blocks from heygen-com/hyperframes (Apache-2.0) and your own .html files; GSAP plugins a block needs must be listed in the story (see README)

props.src: a HyperFrames .html next to story.json (the build puts it into the page); empty = the built-in card
props.canvas: [width, height] the block was designed for (default 1920x1080)
props.dur: seconds to play (stop before the block's own exit)
props.text: {css selector: words} written into the block before its script runs
props.title: built-in card: the large line
props.caption: built-in card: the line under it

example.title: HTML and a timeline
example.caption: This card is one HTML file with a paused GSAP timeline, played as it is.
